title: Glade organ table
description: Organs of an L-Py grass model sampled at several times; the track is the healthy growth baseline, decline is applied by consumers. Lengths in metres, angles in radians, time in phyllochrons. Organs are sorted by (birth_time, id) within a sample; consumers must key organs by id, not by position.

model.description: File name of the L-Py model.

seed.description: Value of the SEED extern used for this export.

params.description: Every extern of the model by name.

organ_events.description: Every leaf of the export by id (in (birth_time, id) order) to its event times (G38). A consumer rebuilds senescence(t) = clamp((t - senescent_time) / senescence_duration, 0, 1) and fade(t) = clamp((t - death_time) / FADE_DURATION, 0, 1), and hides the leaf for t >= collapse_time. null: the event does not happen by t_end.

senescent_time.description: Time of the step before the first senescent step (senescence is 0 there and rises by DT / senescence_duration per step).

death_time.description: Time of the first dead step (fade is 0 there and rises by DT / FADE_DURATION per step).

collapse_time.description: Time of the first step with fade 1.

attach.description: Collar position: tiller base plus tiller axis times sheath length.

direction.description: Unit initial blade direction in world space; authoritative over azimuth_rad and angle_from_axis_rad.

angle_from_axis_rad.description: Healthy baseline at the leaf age (no senescence, fade or decline terms). Angle between the initial blade direction and the tiller axis; azimuth_rad is measured about the same tiller axis.

sheath_length_m.description: Healthy baseline at the leaf age; 0 once fade is 1 (collapsed). Senescence, fade and decline are applied by consumers.

blade_length_m.description: Healthy baseline at the leaf age; 0 once fade is 1 (collapsed). Senescence, fade and decline are applied by consumers.

blade_width_m.description: Healthy baseline at the leaf age; 0 once fade is 1 (collapsed). Senescence, fade and decline are applied by consumers.

arch_rad.description: Healthy baseline at the leaf age; senescence and decline are applied by consumers.

senescence.description: Turnover senescence: 0 green, 1 dead. Equals 1 if and only if state is dead.

fade.description: 0 until the leaf dies, then rises to 1 (collapsed: zero sizes, attach at the tiller base). Positive only when dead, never decreases.

decline_draw.description: Per-leaf unit draw in [-1, 1] made at birth; decline.py scales it by DECLINE_JITTER to shift the leaf's death point.

senescence_duration.description: Time from turning senescent to dead, a per-leaf draw made at birth; senescence rises by DT / senescence_duration per step.
